notice: PLACEHOLDER. This is a draft written by the viewer authors, not a specified standard. Replace it with the schema that your project specifies (load a file in the Classify drawer, or bundle one with the packager). Discipline codes follow the Throughline Discipline code list where it has an entry (origin "throughline"); the other codes are common AEC disciplines (origin "added").

disciplines.label: Architectural
disciplines.description: Building envelope and interior fit-out that is not primarily structural: walls, partitions, doors, windows, finishes, roofs, stairs, furniture.

subDisciplines.label: Walls and partitions
subDisciplines.description: Non-structural walls, partitions and cladding walls.

subDisciplines.label: Doors and frames
subDisciplines.description: Doors, door frames and hardware.

subDisciplines.label: Windows and glazing
subDisciplines.description: Windows, curtain walls, glazing, mullions and shading.

subDisciplines.label: Floors, ceilings and finishes
subDisciplines.description: Floor, ceiling and wall finishes and coverings.

subDisciplines.label: Roofing and envelope
subDisciplines.description: Roofs, roof coverings, insulation and weather membranes.

subDisciplines.label: Stairs and railings
subDisciplines.description: Stairs, ramps and railings.

subDisciplines.label: Furnishings and equipment
subDisciplines.description: Furniture, casework, fittings and conveying equipment.

disciplines.label: Structural
disciplines.description: Load-bearing frame and foundations: footings, piles, columns, beams, slabs, structural walls, bracing, reinforcement.

subDisciplines.label: Foundations and piles
subDisciplines.description: Footings, pile caps, piles and foundation walls.

subDisciplines.label: Columns
subDisciplines.description: Columns and pillars.

subDisciplines.label: Beams and framing
subDisciplines.description: Beams, girders and framing members.

subDisciplines.label: Slabs and decks
subDisciplines.description: Floor and roof slabs and structural decks.

subDisciplines.label: Structural walls
subDisciplines.description: Load-bearing walls, shear walls and cores.

subDisciplines.label: Bracing and connections
subDisciplines.description: Bracing, plates, connections and other structural members.

subDisciplines.label: Reinforcement
subDisciplines.description: Reinforcing bars, meshes and tendons.

disciplines.label: Mechanical and HVAC
disciplines.description: Heating, ventilation and air conditioning: ducts, air terminals, fans, air handling, chillers, boilers, hydronic piping.

subDisciplines.label: Ductwork
subDisciplines.description: Duct segments and duct fittings.

subDisciplines.label: Air terminals and diffusers
subDisciplines.description: Air terminals, diffusers, grilles and terminal boxes.

subDisciplines.label: HVAC equipment
subDisciplines.description: Fans, air handling units, chillers, boilers, coils, heat recovery.

subDisciplines.label: Hydronic piping
subDisciplines.description: Heating and cooling water piping and fittings.

subDisciplines.label: Dampers and duct accessories
subDisciplines.description: Dampers, silencers and other duct accessories.

disciplines.label: Plumbing
disciplines.description: Building plumbing: domestic water supply, sanitary drainage and vent, storm drainage, fixtures and plumbing equipment.

subDisciplines.label: Domestic water supply
subDisciplines.description: Cold and hot domestic water piping and fittings.

subDisciplines.label: Sanitary drainage and vent
subDisciplines.description: Waste, soil and vent piping, floor drains, interceptors.

subDisciplines.label: Plumbing fixtures
subDisciplines.description: Sinks, basins, toilets, urinals, showers and taps.

subDisciplines.label: Plumbing equipment
subDisciplines.description: Water heaters, booster pumps and plumbing tanks.

subDisciplines.label: Storm drainage
subDisciplines.description: Roof drains and storm water piping inside the building.

disciplines.label: Fire protection
disciplines.description: Fire suppression: sprinklers, standpipes, hose connections, fire pumps and tanks, extinguishers.

subDisciplines.label: Sprinkler systems
subDisciplines.description: Sprinkler heads and sprinkler piping.

subDisciplines.label: Standpipes and hose
subDisciplines.description: Standpipes, hose reels and fire department connections.

subDisciplines.label: Fire pumps and tanks
subDisciplines.description: Fire pumps, jockey pumps and fire water tanks.

subDisciplines.label: Extinguishers and special agents
subDisciplines.description: Extinguishers, cabinets and special suppression agents.

disciplines.label: Electrical
disciplines.description: Electrical power and lighting: switchboards, transformers, cable trays, conduit, cables, luminaires, sockets, generators.

subDisciplines.label: Power distribution
subDisciplines.description: Switchboards, panelboards, transformers, breakers and motor connections.

subDisciplines.label: Conduit and cable trays
subDisciplines.description: Cable trays, ladders, conduit and their fittings.

subDisciplines.label: Cable and wiring
subDisciplines.description: Cables, wires and junction boxes.

subDisciplines.label: Lighting
subDisciplines.description: Luminaires and lamps.

subDisciplines.label: Wiring devices
subDisciplines.description: Switches, sockets, outlets and similar wiring devices.

subDisciplines.label: Generation and storage
subDisciplines.description: Generators, batteries, UPS and solar devices.

disciplines.label: Telecom and low voltage
disciplines.description: Telecom and low voltage: data and voice networks, audio and video, security and access control, fire alarm and detection.

subDisciplines.label: Data and communications
subDisciplines.description: Data, voice and network equipment, outlets and cabling.

subDisciplines.label: Audio and visual
subDisciplines.description: Audio and visual equipment.

subDisciplines.label: Security and access
subDisciplines.description: Security cameras, card readers and access control.

subDisciplines.label: Fire alarm and detection
subDisciplines.description: Fire alarm panels, detectors, sounders and call points.

disciplines.label: Civil and site
disciplines.description: Civil and site works outside the building: earthwork, roads, paving, site drainage and utilities, landscaping.

subDisciplines.label: Earthwork
subDisciplines.description: Excavation, fill, grading and geotechnical elements.

subDisciplines.label: Paving and roads
subDisciplines.description: Roads, pavements, kerbs and rail track.

subDisciplines.label: Site drainage
subDisciplines.description: Site storm and sewer drainage, culverts and chambers.

subDisciplines.label: Site utilities
subDisciplines.description: Site water, gas and utility mains.

subDisciplines.label: Landscape and site improvements
subDisciplines.description: Planting, fences, site furniture and other site improvements.

disciplines.label: Piping and process
disciplines.description: Piping and process: process and utility piping, valves, supports, vessels, process pumps and compressors, heat exchangers.

subDisciplines.label: Process piping
subDisciplines.description: Process piping segments and fittings.

subDisciplines.label: Utility piping
subDisciplines.description: Utility piping such as air, steam, water and nitrogen.

subDisciplines.label: Valves and in-line items
subDisciplines.description: Valves and in-line items.

subDisciplines.label: Pipe supports
subDisciplines.description: Pipe supports, hangers and guides.

subDisciplines.label: Vessels and tanks
subDisciplines.description: Vessels, drums and tanks.

subDisciplines.label: Process equipment
subDisciplines.description: Other process equipment.

subDisciplines.label: Pumps and compressors
subDisciplines.description: Process pumps and compressors.

subDisciplines.label: Heat exchangers
subDisciplines.description: Heat exchangers, coolers and heaters.

disciplines.label: Instrumentation
disciplines.description: Instrumentation and control: sensors, transmitters, controllers, actuators, control networks.

subDisciplines.label: Sensors and transmitters
subDisciplines.description: Sensors, transmitters, meters and gauges.

subDisciplines.label: Controllers and actuators
subDisciplines.description: Controllers, actuators and control valves.

subDisciplines.label: Control networks
subDisciplines.description: Control networks, fieldbus and junction boxes for instruments.

disciplines.label: General and unclassified
disciplines.description: Fallback for an element that no other discipline fits. Always needs review.

subDisciplines.label: Unclassified
subDisciplines.description: Unclassified.
